new.statement: Young games advertising redeem codes show weaker Top Trending momentum among games of similar age
new.action: Skip code lists in the description

new.statement: Physics-sandbox games rank higher on Up-and-Coming among games of the same age
Story and adventure loops earn a higher Top Earning position for their CCU than other profiled loops
Physics-sandbox loops earn a lower Top Earning position for their CCU than other profiled loops
Verified creators hold their games on Most Popular for more days

Games that ship a new themed map every one to three days (Clean The Ballpit: house, mall, fair, beach, museum, cruise, space, medieval in 17 days) reach all four charts within three weeks but sit among the least efficient earners
new.action: Ship a new themed map every few days
new.rationale: Clean The Ballpit is on Most Popular, Top Trending, Up-and-Coming and Top Earning at 21 days old, yet is among the weakest on monetization efficiency. Confirm by tracking updates_per_week against te_eff for other young games with dated map lists in their description; refute if its efficiency catches up over the next weeks.

new.statement: Cast-and-place creature loops (Fish For Sea Animals, Pull a Dino, Fish for Secret Animals, Throw Food For Animals) are the successor to the steal/egg template: a throw or cast sets rarity, the creature then pays income per second from a base
new.rationale: Four such games sit in today's top charts or Up-and-Coming and its biggest Top Earning risers (Pull a Dino +71). Confirm if they hold position longer than the steal-a-X clones tracked in H-x-011; refute if they fade within about five weeks like the steal wave.

new.statement: Fan games on a single anime franchise using the +1 template (Avengers, Sukuna, Bow Forge) churn on Up-and-Coming but keep earning through very large pass catalogues (50 passes, 270 products in +1 Sukuna Evolution)
new.rationale: +1 Sukuna Evolution is 24 days old with 50 passes and is in Top Earning's top 260, while +1 Avengers Evolution fell 34 on Up-and-Coming the same day. Confirm with passes_n against te_eff among +1 titles.

qualitative_updates.note: Steal-a-X clones keep falling (Scare Your Favorite Streamer is the exception, +21 on Most Popular), while Steal An Egg still leads Most Popular.

Ragdoll sandboxes: BAD Ragdoll City, Animal Ragdoll, Ragdoll Experiment and Hyper Realistic Ragdoll hold Up-and-Coming and Top Trending leads, but BoneBox Engine and Ragdoll Research fell 12 on Most Popular.
